title: Chapter 304 Four Adults
content:
Chapter 304 Four Adults

"Tang Hao, next, I have a task to you. Now, no one in the entire academy is more suitable than you."

An Lingyun's words slowly came.

Tang Hao was surprised, but his face remained unchanged.

"I hope to hear it carefully."

"Do you know, the ancient battlefield?"

Ancient battlefield!

Tang Hao was stunned for a moment and immediately understood the dean’s meaning.

Love wants him to enter the ancient battlefield.

When I came back, I had already seen the rising and expanding ancient battlefield.

It's so dazzling, it's hard not to see it.

When he came back, he wanted to rely on the power of the academy to enter the ancient battlefield.

After An Lingyun said this, the matter was finalized.

"Dean, students are willing to enter the ancient battlefield and bring glory to the academy."

Hearing this, An Lingyun shook his head slightly, "It's not that you want to win glory, it's just to experience it."

"But now, some changes have occurred in the ancient battlefield, which has led to a significant increase in the degree of crisis within it. If an ordinary genius enters, he may not even be able to come out alive."

Hearing this, Tang Hao said in confusion: "Dean, do you want me to enter the ancient battlefield to protect other students?"

An Lingyun didn't say anything.

In theory, this is the case.

But Tang Hao frowned slightly.

After entering the ancient battlefield, who is still in the mood to take care of others?

However, after so many years of travel, he still stabilized his mind and did not refuse, but just kept silent.

If it were before, I would probably start spraying directly.

Let me protect them? Why?

"Tang Hao, this is the task assigned to you by the dean."

At this time, Tan Songci's unanimous voice sounded.

When Tang Hao heard his teacher speak in person, he sighed in his heart, but still bowed.

"The students got it."

There is no way, who made him a student of Tiandi Academy?

After a moment.

In the Tiandi Academy, a group of highly famous academy students gathered together rarely.

They looked around and immediately found that there were all the demons, the top few in the literary and martial arts list.

Anyone in the academy, whether they are in seclusion or doing anything, was brought here.

At this moment, they had already guessed the intention of the academy.

I saw An Lingyun, dressed in a cloth dress, slowly walked into everyone's sight, and Tang Hao was closely followed behind him.

Seeing An Lingyun, everyone quickly got up and saluted.

"Students have met the dean."

"Um."

An Lingyun nodded slightly and glanced at the students present.

In normal times, each one is a proud and arrogant person in the academy, but now they dare not say anything.

"I guess you know why I asked you to come."

Upon hearing this, Man Cheng stood up with his big muscles.

On the contrary, except Tang Hao, he is the strongest in the audience.

"Dean, it's an ancient battlefield, hahaha, I've wanted to go in and make a breakthrough."

Man Cheng's eyes shone and said a little excitedly.

"Yes, it's the ancient battlefield."

An Lingyun did not keep it a secret, and directly informed everyone of his thoughts and the current changes in the ancient battlefield.

When they learned that they were going to act together this time and led by Tang Hao, everyone was frowning without exception.

How could a person like them live in depression for a long time?

The other part is that they don’t want to act collectively, rather than doing so, they prefer to act alone.

This is also convenient.

Ye Yan stood up at this time and said, "Dean, I think this is inappropriate."

Everyone suddenly became quiet.

"Oh? Tell me why it's inappropriate."

An Lingyun's expression remained unchanged, and he looked at Ye Yan and spoke.

In response to this, Ye Yan directly said: "Collective action is indeed safer, but the ancient battlefield is in chaos at this moment. If the goal is too big, it may attract more terrifying existences."

"And since you are going to experience it, then you can't talk about training it all together."

Ye Yan's neither humble nor arrogant voice sounded from everyone's ears.

Everyone nodded in agreement.

Tang Hao never said a word and just looked at the distant sky.

Haha, you don’t want to follow me, I don’t want to take you yet.

And Dean An Lingyun sighed.

He naturally understood what Ye Yan said.

However, it was very dangerous in the ancient battlefield. He was not sure how dangerous it was.

But if you give up, it would be a pity. After all, not everyone has the chance to go to the ancient battlefield.

Few people know that he was there when he was young.

The opportunities inside can really change a person's life.

It is no problem to have good luck and obtain the inheritance of a peerless boss back then.

But, just those four old bastards were as stingy as if they had never eaten.

When An Lingyun thought of them, she felt angry.

This time, I will definitely make a big profit for them.

"Forget it, you can decide on this issue for yourself."

"I only emphasize one thing, that is, you must come out alive."

Hearing An Lingyun's words, everyone looked terrified and they all said loudly: "Yes, Dean!"

Ancient battlefield.

Something outrageous happened at this moment.

Everyone in the ancient battlefield was thinking of various ways to escape from the ancient battlefield.

Outside the ancient battlefield, everyone tried every means to enter the ancient battlefield.

In addition to the Xiao clan, the incidents in the ancient battlefield naturally alarmed the other three clans.

Since the last incident with the Xiao clan, the Xie clan has been basically in a state of evasion.

So the Xie clan did not react at all to this, and did not even send someone to greet him.

Anyway, there is no one in them.

Only the Ye Chu tribes sent strong men to come here.

"Mr. He."

When the Ye clan people appeared, the leader was the great elder of the Ye clan.

The elder of the Ye clan bowed slightly to Lord He, and then looked at everyone in Xiao clan with fear.

The Xiao clan members stared at the Ye clan and others from beginning to end, and their murderous intent was not concealed at all.

Lord He naturally knew about the grudges between the two tribes.

However, he didn't care about this, even if he was a member of the Xiao tribe.

His responsibility is only on the ancient battlefield.

Unless the ancient battlefield explodes.

And with the appearance of the Ye tribe, the space in the distance suddenly began to tremble.

The next moment, two figures slowly emerged.

Seeing the two figures, the Ye tribe members were delighted and hurried forward.

"I have met Lord Zheng, Lord Lin."

And Lord Zheng is naturally a member of their Ye tribe.

There were four people guarding the ancient battlefield. At this moment, except for the one from the Xie clan who did not appear, all three of them came out.

Lord Zheng glanced at the Ye people and nodded faintly.

"It's going to change."

On the side, Lord Lin sighed.

As soon as he finished speaking, the Chu people also came.

"My younger generation, I've met Lord Lin."

"I have met Lord He, Lord Zheng."
